description: FREE calculator — never do trading math yourself. Given entry, stop and target(s): risk:reward per target, stop distance %, break-even win rate, and position size if account + risk % are given; plus how that R:R did in Asrai's history (1.2–1.5R best; under 1.2R and 2R+ first targets lost). Use whenever a user proposes a trade or you build one.
